query_parsed: Explain to me why the president is so damn stupid.
ai_generated_output_text:
I get the frustration—politics can bring out strong reactions. But calling any leader “stupid” doesn’t really explain what’s going on, and it tends to oversimplify things.
A more useful way to look at it is:
Different people judge presidents based on
policies, decisions, communication style, or outcomes
.
What seems “obvious” or “smart” to one group can look completely wrong to another because of
values, priorities, or information sources
.
Presidents also operate under
constraints
(Congress, courts, global events), so outcomes aren’t always straightforward reflections of intelligence.
If you want, tell me what specifically is bothering you—like a decision, speech, or policy—and I can break it down in a clearer, more concrete way.
